d1-kyber.summary: Research firm SemiAnalysis reported that Nvidia's Kyber NVL144 rack-scale architecture — the cabinet designed to house 2027 Rubin Ultra chips, packing 144 GPUs per unit — has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028, because the specialized multi-layer PCB midplane that connects the system's modules remains challenging from a manufacturability standpoint. The design had been slated to debut with Vera Rubin Ultra in 2027. Nvidia rejected the report (see separate item).
source_passages: Nvidia 's next marquee product — the Kyber rack-scale architecture designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips — has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028, according to research firm SemiAnalysis, the latest in a string of reported setbacks raising questions about the AI giant's product roadmap.
The setback stems from difficulties manufacturing a key circuit board at the heart of the system, SemiAnalysis said in a post on Monday.

"Kyber NVL144 rack architecture has been delayed to 2028 as the PCB midplane remains challenging from a manufacturability standpoint," the firm said, referring to a specialized, multi-layer printed circuit board that connects electronic modules within a system.

d1-kyber.summary: Nvidia rejected SemiAnalysis's report that its Kyber rack-scale architecture has been delayed, stating that its roadmap is intact.
source_passages: Nvidia rejected the SemiAnalysis report and said, "Our roadmap is intact."

d1-memory.summary: Morgan Stanley Research puts memory content per Vera Rubin rack at about $2 million, a 435% jump from the prior generation, driven by a threefold increase in LPDDR5X capacity to 54 terabytes per rack plus roughly $1 million or more in 3D NAND storage; memory rose to 25-30% of the bill of materials from 5-10%, while the GPU's share fell from about 63% to 51%.
source_passages: Morgan Stanley puts memory content per rack at about $2 million, a 435% jump from the prior generation, driven by a threefold increase in LPDDR5X capacity to 54 terabytes per rack plus roughly $1 million or more in 3D NAND storage that was virtually absent from earlier systems.
As a share of the bill of materials, memory rose from 5 to 10 percent on the GB200 to 25 to 30 percent on the VR200, while the GPU's share fell from roughly 63 percent to 51 percent.

d1-memory.summary: MarketScale reports that constrained supply of DRAM, NAND and high-bandwidth memory against AI-driven demand has pushed contract DDR5 pricing sharply higher, with device makers including Samsung and Apple expected to pass higher memory costs into upcoming products, and that memory supply tightness now warrants the same scheduling and planning attention as GPU allocation, with procurement structure able to move rack pricing by $1+ million.

But the force behind the price, constrained supply of DRAM, NAND, and high-bandwidth memory against AI-driven demand, is the same one now raising component costs across the market. Contract DDR5 pricing has climbed sharply, and device makers including Samsung and Apple are expected to pass higher memory costs into upcoming products.

d2-kyber.summary: Research firm SemiAnalysis reported that NVIDIA's Kyber NVL144 rack architecture, the rack-scale system designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips, has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028 because the multi-layer PCB midplane remains difficult to manufacture, and that the larger NVL576 system (eight racks linked optically) is also likely delayed or limited to small volumes. SemiAnalysis concluded this leaves NVIDIA with no proven solution to expand scale-up world size for Rubin Ultra, which it said could give AMD and Google a rare technical opening at the high end of the market.
source_passages: Nvidia 's next marquee product — the Kyber rack-scale architecture designed to house its 2027 Rubin Ultra chips — has been delayed by more than 12 months to 2028, according to research firm SemiAnalysis, the latest in a string of reported setbacks raising questions about the AI giant's product roadmap.

"Kyber NVL144 rack architecture has been delayed to 2028 as the PCB midplane remains challenging from a manufacturability standpoint," the firm said, referring to a specialized, multi-layer printed circuit board that connects electronic modules within a system.
NVL576 — a larger system linking eight racks via optical connections — is also likely delayed or limited to small volumes, the research firm said.

That leaves Nvidia with "no proven solution to expand the scale-up world size for Rubin Ultra," SemiAnalysis said, predicting that could give rivals Advanced Micro Devices and Google , whose in-house chips are already winning business from top AI labs, a rare technical opening at the high end of the market.

d2-kyber.summary: NVIDIA rejected SemiAnalysis's report of a Kyber/Rubin Ultra delay, stating that "Our roadmap is intact."
